paras: 14 Days Mount Abu-Udaipur-Chittorgarh-Pushkar-Jaipur-Bikaner-Jaisalmer-Jodhpur Tour Package
Tour Code #DR070
Rs.30999/- per person
Day 01 – Arrival in Mount Abu

Mount Abu, Serene hill station with stunning sunsets and spiritual retreats amidst luxuriant greenery and peaceful lakes. Upon arrival at the Railway station/Airport, our representative will welcome you. Check-in at the hotel. Enjoy a unique sunset experience in Mount Abu.
Night stay at Mt. Abu Hotel.
Day 02 – Mount Abu Sightseeing
After breakfast, explore the major attractions of Mount Abu:
Delwara Temple: Abstract of architectural brilliance.
Vedi Temple: Serene residence of divine energy.
Nakki Lake: Peaceful oasis amidst hills.
Sunset Point: Spectacular vistas at dusk.
Tod Rock: Natural wonder carved beautifully.
Guru Shikhar: Summit of spiritual peacefulness.
Achalgarh Mahadev: Ancient temple amidst nature.
Brahma Kumari Ashram: Retreat for inner peace seekers.
Overnight stay at Mount Abu Hotel.
Day 03 – Mount Abu - Udaipur

Udaipur, Captivating Lake city decorated with palaces, museums, and vibrant culture, offering a royal feeling with Rajasthan's heritage. After breakfast, drive to Udaipur, the lake city. Check-in at the hotel and enjoy the day at leisure.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Udaipur.
Day 04 – Udaipur Sightseeing
After breakfast, explore every corner of the Lake city:
City Palace: Royal brilliance in architecture marvel.
Jagdish Temple: Sacred heaven of spiritual comfort.
Bhartiya Lok Kala Mandal: Cultural heritage in vibrant display.
Pratap Smarak: Tribute to heroism and bravery.
Shilp Gram: Artisans' territory preserving traditions.
Bagore ki Haveli: Architectural grace echoing history.
Saheliyon ki Bari: Garden of royal peacefulness.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Udaipur.
Day 05 – Udaipur – Ajmer/Pushkar
Ajmer, A city of spiritual resonance, where the Dargah Sharif and ancient architecture weave together a beauty of mysticism and history.
Pushkar, Sacred town known for its serene lake, colourful bazaars, and spiritual aura, hosting the world-famous Brahma Temple and camel fair.
After breakfast, proceed to Pushkar. Check-in at the hotel and visit Ajmer & Pushkar:
Dargah of Khwaja Muin-ud-din Chisti at Ajmer: Pilgrimage of peace and faith.
Lord Brahma Temple at Pushkar: Sacred residence of divine grace.
Overnight stay at Pushkar Hotel.
Day 06 – Pushkar - Jaipur

Jaipur, The Pink City waves with its majestic forts, palaces, busy markets, and vibrant cultural experiences, a kaleidoscope of Rajasthan's royal charm. After breakfast, proceed to Jaipur. Check-in at the hotel. In the evening, visit the modern attractions of the Pink City:
Statue Circle: Iconic landmark of public pride.
Birla Auditorium & Planetarium: Cultural hub for arts devotees.
Vidhan Sabha: Legislative seat of governance.
Birla Mandir: Serene heaven of spiritual comfort.
Jawahar Kala Kendra: Artistic sanctuary of creative expression.
Enjoy a Rajasthani dinner at a resort with folk music and cultural dance.
Day 07 – Jaipur Sightseeing
After breakfast, explore the old Pink City:
Hawa Mahal: Palace of Winds in Jaipur.
City Palace: Majestic royal residence in Jaipur.
Observatory / Jantar Mantar: Ancient astronomical marvel in Jaipur.
Jal Mahal: Water palace in Man Sagar Lake.
Amer Fort: Hilltop fortress near Jaipur.
Nahargarh Fort & Places: Scenic fort with stunning views.
Enjoy the Light & Sound show at Amer Fort in the evening.
Day 08 – Jaipur – Mandawa - Bikaner
Bikaner, Desert jewel boasting ornate palaces, camel safaris, and savoury cookery delights, where history and heritage blend seamlessly in the arid landscape.
After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed to Bikaner. Enroute, visit Mandawa. Later, continue to Bikaner.
Overnight stay at Bikaner Hotel.
Day 09 – Bikaner Sightseeing
After breakfast, explore the amazing places of Bikaner:
Junagarh Fort: Majestic fort in Bikaner.
Camel Breeding Farm: Hub for Bikaneri camels.
Karni Mata Temple: Famous rat temple in Bikaner.
Overnight stay at Bikaner Hotel.
Day 10 – Bikaner - Jaisalmer

Jaisalmer, The Golden City charms with its ancient fort, skilled carved havelis, and desert adventures under starry skies, a gateway to Rajasthan's desert life.After breakfast, drive to Jaisalmer. Check-in at the hotel. Freshen up and visit the places of the Golden City:
War Museum: History preserved in Jaisalmer.
Gadisar Lake: Serene oasis in Jaisalmer.
Vyas Chhatri: Architectural marvel in Jaisalmer.
Overnight stay at Jaisalmer Hotel.
Day 11 – Jaisalmer Sightseeing & Desert
After breakfast, visit the attractions of Jaisalmer:
Jaisalmer Fort & Palaces: Iconic desert citadel in Rajasthan.
Jain Temples: Intricate marble temples in Jaisalmer.
Patwon ki Haveli: Ornate sandstone mansion in Jaisalmer.
Salim Singh ki Haveli: Architectural gem of Jaisalmer.
Nathmal ki Haveli: Twin havelis with magnificent architecture.
Experience a night in the desert camp with cultural programs, camel ride, bonfire, sunset, and dinner.
Day 12 – Jaisalmer – Jodhpur

Jodhpur, Blue City is known for its imposing forts, busy markets, and royal palaces, where every corner telling story of heroism and brilliance. After breakfast, check out from the desert camp and proceed to Jodhpur. Check-in at the hotel. Rest of the day at leisure.
Overnight stay at Jodhpur Hotel.
Day 13 – Jodhpur Sightseeing
After breakfast, explore the amazing places of the Blue City:
Ummaid Bhawan Palace Museum: Majestic blend of heritage marvel.
Jaswant Thada: Peaceful white marble monument.
Mehrangarh Fort: Iconic fortress overlooking Jodhpur.
Clock Tower & Markets: Vibrant heart of Jodhpur.
Overnight stay at Jodhpur Hotel.
Day 14 – Jodhpur Departure
After breakfast, you will be dropped at Jodhpur Railway station or Airport.
(The Tour Ends)
Package Inclusions:
* Daily breakfast
* Air-conditioned car for transportation throughout the journey
* Driver allowance, fuel, parking fees, and all applicable taxes
* Accommodation in 3-star hotels
* Government-approved tourist guide service for sightseeing in Jaipur
* Camel Ride, Bonfire, Hi-Tea, Cultural Programs & Vegetarian Dinner at Desert Camp
* Complimentary accommodation for children below 5 years of age
Package Exclusions:
* Meals other than those specified in the inclusions
* Personal expenses such as tips, telephone calls, and laundry
* Entrance fees to monuments and attractions
* Camera fees
* Any tickets for trains, flights, or buses
* Travel insurance
Things to note
* Prices are quoted per person based on triple sharing.
* Rates may vary during peak seasons such as New Year and Diwali.
14 Days Delhi-Agra-Jaipur-Ajmer/Pushkar-Udaipur-Mount Abu-Jodhpur-Jaisalmer-Bikaner-Jaipur Tour Package
Tour Code #DR071
Rs.30599/- per person
Day 01: Arrival in Delhi

Delhi, A busy metropolis where history and modernism lives, offering vibrant markets, iconic monuments, and rich cultural experiences. Upon your arrival at the railway station or airport, our representative will warmly welcome you. Check-in at the hotel. Delhi, India's capital, is renowned for its attractions, food, and markets. Enjoy shopping and submerge yourself in the rich cultural heritage of the city.
Overnight stay in Delhi.
Day 02: Delhi Sightseeing
After breakfast, explore the iconic attractions of Delhi:
Red Fort: Majestic symbol of Mughal grandeur.
Purana Quila (Old Fort): Ancient stronghold of Delhi's history.
Jama Masjid: Iconic symbol of Islamic architecture.
Qutub Minar: Tallest brick minaret in the world.
India Gate: Memorial honouring Indian soldiers.
Chandni Chowk: Busy heart of Old Delhi.
Lakshmi Narayan Temple: Serene residence of divine grace.
Overnight stay in Delhi.
Day 03: Delhi - Agra
Agra, Home to the Taj Mahal, Agra resonates with Mughal luxury, showcasing architectural marvels and a timeless symbol of love.
After breakfast, proceed to Agra. Check-in at the hotel and relax. Later, visit:
Taj Mahal: Everlasting symbol of love's perfection.
Agra Fort: Historical stronghold of Mughals.
Itimad-Ud-Daulah (Baby Taj): Delicate ancestor to magnificence.
Explore Agra's Markets: Vibrant hubs of local culture.
Overnight stay in Agra.
Day 04: Agra - Jaipur

Jaipur, The Pink City of Rajasthan, renowned for its royal heritage, majestic forts, vibrant bazaars, and colourful cultural traditions. After breakfast, drive to Jaipur. Check-in at the hotel. In the evening, visit Jaipur's modern attractions:
Statue Circle: Iconic landmark of Jaipur.
Birla Auditorium & Planetarium: Modern hub of cultural wisdom.
Vidhan Sabha: Seat of legislative power.
Birla Mandir: Temple of peaceful devotion.
Jawahar Kala Kendra: Artistic heart of Jaipur.
Enjoy a Rajasthani dinner at a resort with folk dance and music.
Day 05: Jaipur Sightseeing
After breakfast, explore Jaipur's historic attractions:
Hawa Mahal: Palace of Winds magnificence.
City Palace: Royal residence of Jaipur.
Jantar Mantar (Observatory): Enormous marvel of history.
Jal Mahal: Palace amidst the lake.
Amer Fort: Castle of brilliance.
Nahargarh Fort: Majestic views over Jaipur.
In the evening, enjoy the Light & Sound show at Amer Fort.
Day 06: Jaipur - Ajmer - Pushkar - Udaipur
Ajmer, A spiritual retreat known for the revered Dargah Sharif, mixing religious significance with historical charm and a peaceful environment.
Pushkar, Famous for its sacred Brahma Temple and vibrant Pushkar Fair, this holy town emits spiritual serenity and cultural vibrancy.
After breakfast, proceed to Udaipur via Ajmer and Pushkar. Visit:
Dargah of Khwaja Muin-ud-din Chishti at Ajmer: Spiritual center of Sufism.
Lord Brahma Temple at Pushkar: Holy place of Pushkar.
Later, continue to Udaipur and check-in at the hotel.
Overnight stay in Udaipur.
Day 07: Udaipur Sightseeing
Udaipur, The City of Lakes captivates with its regal palaces, shimmering lakes, lavish gardens, and romantic ambiance, epitomizing Rajasthan's charm.
After breakfast, explore the charming attractions of Udaipur:
City Palace: Royal residence of Mewar kings.
Pratap Smarak: Tribute to Maharana Pratap's bravery.
Bhartiya Lok Kala Mandal: Showcasing Rajasthan's cultural heritage.
Saheliyon ki Bari: Garden of royal maidens.
Jagdish Temple: Skilled architecture dedicated to Vishnu.
Bagore ki Haveli: Cultural Museum with folk art.
Shilp Gram: Craftsmen's village celebrating art.
Fateh Sagar Lake: Scenic beauty in Udaipur.
Overnight stay in Udaipur.
Day 08: Udaipur - Mount Abu

Mount Abu, Rajasthan's only hill station, offers cool climate, scenic landscapes, and spiritual retreats amidst the Aravalli Range. After breakfast, travel to Mount Abu. Check-in at the hotel. Enjoy leisure time.
Day 09: Mount Abu Sightseeing
After breakfast, visit the major attractions of Mount Abu:
Delwara Temple: Lovely marble architecture in Mount Abu.
Vedi Temple: Peaceful place for meditation.
Nakki Lake: Scenic heart of Mount Abu.
Sunset Point: Spectacular views at dusk.
Tod Rock: Natural rock formation viewpoint.
Guru Shikhar: Highest peak in Aravalli Range.
Achalgarh Mahadev: Ancient Shiva temple fortress.
Brahma Kumari Ashram: Spiritual retreat for meditation.
Overnight stay in Mount Abu.
Day 10: Mount Abu - Ranakpur - Jodhpur

Jodhpur, The Blue City boasts towering forts, luxurious residences, busy markets, and a rich textile of Rajputana culture and hospitality. After breakfast, proceed to Jodhpur via Ranakpur. Visit the renowned Jain temples of Ranakpur. Continue to Jodhpur and check-in at the hotel.
Overnight stay in Jodhpur.
Day 11: Jodhpur Sightseeing
After breakfast, explore the attractions of Jodhpur:
Umaid Bhawan Palace Museum: Royal heritage in modern grace.
Jaswant Thada: Marble marvel of Rajasthan.
Mehrangarh Fort: Majestic stronghold of Jodhpur.
Overnight stay in Jodhpur.
Day 12: Jodhpur - Jaisalmer Desert
Jaisalmer, The Golden City of India, where sand dunes meet skilled carved havelis and the majestic Jaisalmer Fort, raising tales of courage and royalty.
After breakfast, drive to Jaisalmer. Check-in at the hotel. Visit:
Jaisalmer Fort: Golden fortress in desert sands.
Jain Temples: Skilled marvels of architecture.
Patwon ki Haveli: Ornate mansion of sandstone.
Salim Singh ki Haveli: Unique balconies in golden shades.
Nathmal ki Haveli: Twin havelis with skilled carvings.
Later, experience a night in the desert with cultural programs, camel ride, bonfire, and dinner at a desert camp.
Day 13: Jaisalmer - Bikaner
Known for Junagarh Fort, camel safaris, and Karni Mata Temple, Bikaner blends desert charm with architectural brilliance and cultural richness.
After breakfast, proceed to Bikaner. Visit:
Junagarh Fort: Architectural marvel of Rajasthan.
Camel Breeding Farm: Hub of desert animal husbandry.
Karni Mata Temple: Famous rat temple in Rajasthan.
Overnight stay in Bikaner.
Day 14: Bikaner - Jaipur Departure
After breakfast, drive to Jaipur for departure. You will be dropped at Jaipur Railway Station or Airport. The tour concludes here.
